title: Man’s Search for Meaning

blink.heading: The last freedom
blink.body: Everything can be taken from a person but one thing: the freedom to choose one’s attitude in any given set of circumstances.

blink.heading: Meaning, three ways
blink.body: Through work, love, and the courage we summon in unavoidable suffering.

insights: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
applications: When suffering is unavoidable, ask: what is this trying to teach me?
highlights: Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response.

flashcards.front: What are the three sources of meaning according to Frankl?
flashcards.back: Work, love, and the attitude we take toward unavoidable suffering.
